inputs.scope: Output contract lines 405-458 only, plus prior reviewed source retained

findings.finding: audit.json has an external SHA pin, but complete.json does not. The helper authenticates NUL plans only against hashes in that mutable completion file and compares union/disjointness, never the stage_action plan in pinned audit.rows. A modified completion file and a consistently reduced all/normal/force plan can pass both phases and staged exact-set verification with omitted audited changes.
findings.minimal_fix: Derive the exact all/normal/force path lists from pinned audit rows and stage_action using original UTF-8 byte sorting; compare actual NUL file bytes directly. Require completion schema and exact expected file set/hash entries rather than letting it define the only plan trust anchor.
findings.static_oracle: Pinned audit has two normal stage paths; reducing all/normal plans to one path and updating unpinned completion hashes meets current checks. No such modified fixture was created or executed.

findings.finding: Prestage regular checks omit executable mode. Staged absent entries verify only index absence and immediately continue, without current working-tree absence. Staged regular entries verify bytes but omit current executable mode. A deleted path recreated after audit or a working executable-bit change after staging can therefore survive while the receipt claims the current state matches the audited candidate.
findings.minimal_fix: In both phases recheck lstat regular/no-symlink identity plus audited Git executable mode for regular paths, and enforce current absence including dangling symlinks for every absent row. Retain staged blob/mode checks and final index/HEAD/branch bookends.
findings.static_oracle: For an absent row, line55 accepts any recreated working file because no current path read occurs. For a regular row, chmod alone does not affect sha and passes line67. No fixtures executed.

clean_observations: All Git invocations are read-only operations: rev-parse, branch query, diff, ls-files and cat-file; no Git mutation or staging command.
Initial and final HEAD/branch/index byte pins are present, and staged blob length/SHA256/index executable-mode verification is present for regular audited entries.
Unknown staged paths are refused relative to the supplied plan; this does not repair the missing direct plan-to-pinned-audit binding.
Whitespace exit code is retained separately as metadata. passed_content_verification does not imply whitespace success; parent must inspect that result before commit.
